title: Capacitance Runway — Signal Digest & Readiness Map
summary: Compact tracker for upcoming launch window focusing on capacity economics (we call it 'capacitance' here) and the primary signals to unblock go/no-go decisions.

roadmap_milestones: 2025-02-20: Canary launch (10% traffic) - Owner: Marcus Chen - KPI gate: p95 <= 180ms, error_rate < 1%
2025-02-28: Kernel optimization deploy - Owner: Lina Gomez - KPI gate: rps uplift +20% on synthetic bench
2025-03-07: Autoscale tuning + dedicated pool config - Owner: Evan Brooks - KPI gate: cost/1ktokens <= 6.5
2025-03-14: Full ramp to 100% traffic - Owner: Product Ops Lead - KPI gate: adoption >= 4.5k week1
readiness_checklist: Capacity: reserve burst quota for dedicated pool and validate K8s autoscaler hooks
Observability: ensure per-route token-level tracing enabled and dashboard linked to runbook
Rollout policy: default fallback to smaller quantized model on latency breach
Customer comms: landing page + status page snippet + beta cohort email template ready
Security: KMS rotation verified, audit-log sampling enabled for private deployments
QA: end-to-end smoke tests for streaming + function-calling paths pass in staging
SRE: incident runbook reviewed, on-call rotation confirmed for first 72h
Finance: temporary overage approval up to 20% for first 7 days of ramp
risk_matrix: Model regressions | High | Blackbox eval set + rollback flag; freeze prompt pack on canary
Capacity cliff at peak | High | pre-reserve nodes, add circuit-breaker to shed non-critical traffic
Unexpected cost surge | Medium | auto-notify finance + throttle lower-priority routes
Third-party dependency outage | Medium | region failover policy and cached responses
Low beta adoption | Low | rapid experiment on onboarding flow + incentivize cohort
decision_criteria: Green = all KPI gates met for 48h on canary; Yellow = one KPI near threshold with mitigations; Red = any KPI breach w/o immediate mitigation
comms_and_escalation: Slack: #prodops-launch (primary), #sre-oncall (escalation) | Pager duty: PDP-ProdOps | Exec updates: daily 09:30 PST during first 3 days
